property.name: yarn.resourcemanager.webapp.cross-origin.enabled
property.description: Flag to enable cross-origin (CORS) support in the RM. This flag requires the CORS filter initializer to be added to the filter initializers list in core-site.xml.

property.name: yarn.webapp.api-service.enable
property.description: Enable services rest api on ResourceManager. See: https://apache.github.io/hadoop/hadoop-yarn/hadoop-yarn-site/yarn-service/QuickStart.html

property.name: yarn.webapp.ui2.enable
property.description: To enable RM web ui2 application.

property.name: yarn.nodemanager.local-dirs
property.description: List of directories to store localized files in.

property.name: yarn.nodemanager.disk-health-checker.max-disk-utilization-per-disk-percentage
property.description: The maximum percentage of disk space utilization allowed after which a disk is marked as bad. Values can range from 0.0 to 100.0. If the value is greater than or equal to 100, the nodemanager will check for full disk. This applies to yarn.nodemanager.local-dirs and yarn.nodemanager.log-dirs. (default: 90.0)

property.name: yarn.log-aggregation-enable
property.description: Whether to enable log aggregation. Log aggregation collects each container's logs and moves these logs onto a file-system, for e.g. HDFS, after the application completes. Users can configure the "yarn.nodemanager.remote-app-log-dir" and "yarn.nodemanager.remote-app-log-dir-suffix" properties to determine where these logs are moved to. Users can access the logs via the Application Timeline Server. (default: false)

property.name: yarn.log-aggregation.retain-seconds
property.description: How long to keep aggregation logs before deleting them. -1 disables. Be careful set this too small and you will spam the name node. (default: -1)

property.name: yarn.log-aggregation.retain-check-interval-seconds
property.description: How long to wait between aggregated log retention checks. If set to 0 or a negative value then the value is computed as one-tenth of the aggregated log retention time. Be careful set this too small and you will spam the name node. (default: -1)

property.name: yarn.timeline-service.enabled
property.description: In the server side it indicates whether timeline service is enabled or not. And in the client side, users can enable it to indicate whether client wants to use timeline service. If it's enabled in the client side along with security, then yarn client tries to fetch the delegation tokens for the timeline server. (default: false)

property.name: yarn.timeline-service.hostname
property.description: The hostname of the timeline service web application. (default: 0.0.0.0, 각 yarn node 에서 사용)

property.name: yarn.timeline-service.bind-host
property.description: The actual address the server will bind to. If this optional address is set, the RPC and webapp servers will bind to this address and the port specified in yarn.timeline-service.address and yarn.timeline-service.webapp.address, respectively. This is most useful for making the service listen to all interfaces by setting to 0.0.0.0.

property.name: yarn.timeline-service.http-cross-origin.enabled
property.description: Enables cross-origin support (CORS) for web services where cross-origin web response headers are needed. For example, javascript making a web services request to the timeline server. Defaults to false.

property.name: yarn.resourcemanager.system-metrics-publisher.enabled
property.description: The setting that controls whether yarn system metrics is published on the timeline server or not by RM. (default: false)

property.name: yarn.timeline-service.generic-application-history.enabled
property.description: Indicate to clients whether to query generic application data from timeline history-service or not. If not enabled then application data is queried only from Resource Manager.

property.name: yarn.timeline-service.store-class
property.description: Store class name for timeline store. (default: org.apache.hadoop.yarn.server.timeline.LeveldbTimelineStore)

property.name: yarn.timeline-service.leveldb-timeline-store.path
property.description: Store file name for leveldb timeline store. (default: ${hadoop.tmp.dir}/yarn/timeline)

property.name: yarn.timeline-service.leveldb-state-store.path
property.description: Store file name for leveldb state store. (default: ${hadoop.tmp.dir}/yarn/timeline)
